camel_example: aliyun eiam UpdateUser --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --UserId user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx
description_en: Updates the basic information of an EIAM account
description_zh: 更新一个EIAM账户基本信息
kebab_example: aliyun eiam update-user --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --user-id user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateUser

parameters.help_en: The account name. The name can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), at signs (@), and hyphens (-). The name can be up to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 账户名称，可包含英文字母、数字、符号“_” 、“ .”、“@”、“-”，长度最大限制256
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en: The display name of the account. The name can be up to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 账户展示名称，长度最大限制256字符
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The phone region code. Example: 86 for the Chinese mainland, without the 00 or + prefix. This parameter is required if a phone number is specified
parameters.help_zh: 手机地区编号,示例：中国大陆手区号为86，不带 00 或 +, 手机号若设置，此参数必填
parameters.name: phone_region

parameters.help_en: The phone number. The value must be 6 to 15 digits in length
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the phone number is verified as a trusted phone number. This parameter is required if a phone number is specified. If no special business requirements exist, set this parameter to true
parameters.help_zh: 手机号是否验证，为可信手机号，手机号若设置此字段必须设置，无特殊业务可直接设置为true
parameters.name: phone_number_verified

parameters.help_en: The email address. The prefix of the email address can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 邮箱，邮箱前缀可包含大写英文字母、小写英文字母、数字、点、下划线或中划线
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the email address is verified. This parameter is required if an email address is specified. If no special business requirements exist, set this parameter to true
parameters.help_zh: 邮箱是否验证，邮箱若设置此字段必须设置，无特殊业务可直接设置为true
parameters.name: email_verified

fields.help_en: The identifier of the custom field. Create the custom field in advance. For more information, refer to the custom fields module in the console
fields.help_zh: 扩展字段标识，需提前创建相关扩展字段，参考控制台扩展字段模块
fields.name: field_name

fields.help_en: The value of the custom field. The value must comply with the property constraints of the corresponding custom field
fields.help_zh: 扩展字段值，该值遵循对应扩展字段的相关属性限制
fields.name: field_value

fields.help_en:
The operation type for the custom field. Valid values:
add: adds a custom field value to the account.
replace: replaces an existing custom field value of the account. If the custom field value does not exist, the operation is converted to an add operation.
remove: removes the custom field value from the account
fields.help_zh:
扩展字段操作类型，取值可选范围：
add：新增账户扩展字段值。
replace：替换已有账户扩展字段值，如扩展字段值不存在，会转换为add操作。
remove：移除账户扩展字段值
fields.name: operation

parameters.help_en: The list of custom field objects
parameters.name: custom_fields
